notes: The copula 'shall be' goes to hămônāh, the Hebrew clause's predicate, even though the ASV fronts Hamonah as its English subject; rule 20 requires reading the Hebrew for which side is the predicate.
gam's 'also' is postposed in English and the predicate unit is discontinuous around it (rule 25); the second waw takes the connective 'Thus' the ASV wrote for it (rule 14).
